observations: Black multifunction printer wrapped in clear plastic film.
Brand 'KONICA MINOLTA' and model 'bizhub 223' are visible on the front panel in both photos.
The machine has a multi-drawer paper handling system.
A watermark 'SMATECH MEGA EQUIPMENT' is present on both images.
The unit appears to be in a warehouse or storage environment.

claims.evidence: The location of the seller cannot be confirmed from the photos.
This refers to the printer's ability to print, scan, copy, and fax, which cannot be tested remotely.

claims.claim: Low page count, under 20,000 copies. New drum and toner just fitted, no paper jam.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The printer may not power on or may have internal electronic faults.
risks.proof: A video showing the printer powering on and successfully printing a test page.

risks.risk: The toner cartridge may be empty or the drum may be worn out.
risks.proof: A photo of the toner cartridge and a photo of the printer's status page showing the remaining toner level.
risks.if_unproven: as requiring a new toner cartridge

risks.risk: The scanner glass may be scratched or dirty.
risks.proof: A photo of the scanner glass with a document or glass of water.

proof_requests: Video of the printer powering on and printing a test page.
Photo of the toner cartridge and the printer's status page.
Confirmation of the current date to verify the unit's age.
response.reason: The model is clearly identified from the photos. It can be priced at its worst-case value (non-functional) until proof of operation is provided.
